position_on: the key's own pole: cutting child-care costs and expanding early learning, including fully funding Head Start and capping what families pay for child care
confidence_reason: Three of his own Senate releases from 2025 and 2026 say the country has a moral responsibility to provide early childhood education and child care, back his bill to expand and fully fund Head Start and back capping child care at 7% of family income; held at 0.8 because his sources speak to Head Start and cost caps rather than a universal pre-K program by name.

sources.excerpt: "In the richest country in the history of the world, we have a moral responsibility to provide high-quality early childhood education and child care for our children." ... "Let’s expand and fully fund Head Start to make sure it reaches every eligible young child, extend the length of programs so working families don’t have to find additional child care and raise teacher pay so educators are not forced to leave the field or work a second job just to make ends meet."
sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-25 (the release's full text, as published on his Senate site). Release on his 2025 bill to expand early learning. Only the quote attributed to Sanders is used.

sources.note: Read directly on 2026-11-25 (the release's full text, as published on his Senate site). His prepared floor remarks on the 2025 budget, published by his office.
